name: Crinkle paper fill, kraft
claim_wording: 'Recyclable,' with the note 'Recycling facilities for this product may not exist in all areas.' Recycled content not listed.
notes: Uline S-6118 Crinkle Paper 10 lb Kraft, $40/$38/$36 per carton at 1/5/10+. Uline gives only the shipping carton volume (2.3 cu ft, compressed), not fill coverage. COVERAGE ESTIMATED: Packrift (https://packrift.com/products/10-lb-white-crinkle-paper-professional-void-fill-protective-packaging) says a 10 lb case 'typically fills 15-25 medium-sized boxes (12x9x4 inches)'; 12 x 9 x 4 = 432 cu in = 0.25 cu ft, so 15-25 boxes = 3.75-6.25 cu ft; midpoint 5.0 cu ft used. Weight per cu ft = 10 lb x 453.592 / 5.0 = 907 g (range 726-1210 g). Price per cu ft = $40 / 5.0 = $8.00 (1-carton price; basis = 5 cu ft). Treat as rough: real fill density depends on how tightly it is packed. UPDATE 2026-11-16: two supplier coverage figures bracket this estimate: EcoEnclose shred 11 lb fills 13,068 cu in (about 660 g/cu ft); Uline Monster Crinkle 10 lb fills 3.5 cu ft (1,296 g/cu ft). Crinkle is a dense decorative fill, not an efficient void fill.

Price: $27/$26/$25/$24/$21 per roll at 1/3/6/10/20+; 1-roll price $27 -> $0.0240 per sq ft. FILL YIELD ESTIMATED (no supplier figure found): assumed 10 sq ft of crumpled paper fills 1 cu ft of void. Weight = 10 x 6.05 = 60 g per cu ft; price = 10 x $0.0240 = $0.240 per cu ft; basis = one roll = 112.5 cu ft. Rough assumption; test by crumpling 10 sq ft into a 1 cu ft box. Same roll can also be used as wrap. UPDATE 2026-11-16: no published yield for hand-crumpled kraft. Pregis (sells both systems, secondary) says air cushions weigh about one fifth of paper pads for the same volume; with Uline air pillows at 59.3 g/cu ft that implies about 297 g/cu ft for machine paper pads. 60 is likely a low bound; weigh it.

notes: Uline S-1012 Air Bubble Wrap Roll 12 in x 175 ft, 3/16 in, in a dispenser box. Area = 12/12 x 175 = 175 sq ft. name: Honeycomb kraft paper wrap, 12 in roll
claim_wording: '100% recyclable.' 'Recycled Content: 0%'. Compostability not mentioned.
notes: Uline S-26409 Honeycomb Paper Cushioning Roll, 12 in x 1,400 ft expanded (15.25 in x 840 ft unexpanded), 50 lb paper. Area (expanded) = 12/12 x 1,400 = 1,400 sq ft. name: Tissue paper sheets, 20 x 30 in (acid-free)
notes: Uline S-23030 Acid-Free Tissue Paper Sheets 20 x 30 in, 10 lb basis weight, 100 sheets per bundle. Area = 20 x 30 / 144 x 100 = 416.67 sq ft. This is higher than the 10 lb basis weight implies (about 1.6 g/sq ft if basis is per 480 sheets of 24 x 36 in), so the unit weight probably includes packaging; weigh a sheet. Price: $38/$35 per bundle at 1/3+; 1-bundle price -> $0.0912 per sq ft. Protection low (decorative wrap, little cushioning; rule did not cover tissue). No recycled content or recyclability claim on page.
